---
title: "Synthetic fMRI Moderation Demonstration"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
set.seed(42)
n <- 1119
screen_time <- log1p(rgamma(n, shape = 2, scale = 2))
warmth <- scale(rnorm(n, mean = 50, sd = 8))[,1]
roi <- -0.03 * screen_time + 0.015 * screen_time * warmth + rnorm(n, sd = 0.25)
df <- data.frame(screen_time, warmth, roi)
```

## Moderation model

```{r model}
model <- lm(roi ~ screen_time * warmth, data = df)
summary(model)
```

This file is a **synthetic public demonstration**, not the ABCD participant-level analysis and not a reproduction of the original course-project coefficients.
